gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (GAAP) Issuance of Debt 1,965,000 (Special Assessments column only). detail[] holds the Special Assessments budgetary-basis schedule p16: Proceeds from Debt Financing 3,730,000 and Discount on Debt (18,090). 3,730,000 - 1,965,000 = 1,765,000 = the gap; both amounts are printed (GAAP p5 vs budgetary p16), the budgetary schedule records gross debt proceeds that the GAAP statement does not. No missing or duplicate line; no fix.

Statement p5 prints other-financing rows not in detail[]: General column Information Technology Subscriptions 48,529 and Insurance Proceeds 48,688; Special Assessments column Premium on Bonds 37,221. Those funds' schedules in detail[] are the budgetary-basis budget-and-actual schedules: General p10 Other Financing prints only Transfers In 415,000 / Transfers Out (2,772,446); Special Assessments p16 prints Proceeds from Debt Financing 3,730,000, Discount on Debt (18,090), Transfers In 192,940 (all in detail[]). The GAAP rows (subscription recognition, premium, insurance proceeds that the budgetary schedule may hold within its revenue lines) would mix bases and could double count; not added. All transfers on p5 are in detail[] with the right sign (Other Governmental Funds in 1,073,908 = 46,254 + 185,296 + 842,358; out (114,520)).
